'''A brain mapper''' was a device used to scan the brains of beings. A hood was worn over the head while being scanned. Cilghal had one in the medical center of the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Academy]]. [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] had fun playing around with it before being reprimanded by an annoyed [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Master Skywalker]].
